Compute expression metrics for matrisome categories

Source: R/matrisome.R
compute_expression_metrics.Rd

Calculates raw counts, log-scaled, and robust-normalized expression values for a set of genes within each spot.

Usage

compute_expression_metrics(
  gene_list,
  seurat_obj,
  category_name,
  counts_matrix = NULL,
  matrisome_db = NULL
)

Arguments

gene_list

Character vector of gene names

seurat_obj

A Seurat object

category_name

Name for the category (used in column names)

counts_matrix

Pre-fetched counts matrix (optional)

matrisome_db

Matrisome gene database with synonym info

Value

Data frame with expression metrics and coordinates

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
metrics <- compute_expression_metrics(
  gene_list = c("COL1A1", "COL1A2"),
  seurat_obj = my_obj,
  category_name = "Collagens"
)
} # }
